# KevTheFoo Portfolio

Kevin Foo is a software developer from Taiwan who builds for the web and explores blockchain and AI.

## Public API

The versioned, read-only JSON API is available at `/api/v1`.

- Full public profile: `/api/v1/profile`
- Published facts: `/api/v1/facts`
- Projects: `/api/v1/projects`
- Articles: `/api/v1/articles`
- Reviewed questions and answers: `/api/v1/questions`

All endpoints support cross-origin GET requests. Follow the links returned by `/api/v1` to discover the canonical endpoint URLs.
